questions.question: Find the bug that prevents the loop from finishing.
questions.codeSnippet:
i = 0
while i < 5:
    print(i)
    # Missing increment
questions.explanation: The variable i never changes, so the condition i < 5 is always True, causing an infinite loop. The fix is to add i += 1 inside the loop.

questions.question: Find the bug that causes an infinite loop.
questions.codeSnippet:
counter = 5
while counter > 0:
    print(counter)
    counter = counter + 1
questions.explanation: Line 3 increments counter instead of decrementing, so counter grows indefinitely and never reaches 0, causing an infinite loop.
